card.name: "Potential" in pregnancy risk advice
card.fires_on: The word "potential" in the label sentence "Advise pregnant women of the potential risk to a fetus." Weaker hits are on a few other words in label titles, such as "Integrated" in a trial name and "agents" after "antibacterial".

modes.label: Pregnancy advice sentence
modes.description: "potential" right after "Advise pregnant women of the" and before "risk to a fetus".
modes.example: Advise pregnant women of the<< potential>> risk to a fetus. Advise females

modes.label: Other label wording
modes.description: Scattered words such as "Integrated" in a trial name or "agents" after "antibacterial".
modes.example: Prospective Randomized Evaluation of Celecoxib<< Integrated>> Safety vs. Ibuprofen or Nap

card.plain: It fires on the word "potential" in the standard advice to tell pregnant women about the risk to a fetus.
